text_block_list.text:
I brought an injured Dream Journey
to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't hurt that much, so I'm fine.
Let's continue training."

Dream Journey has her usual smile.
...Which is precisely why it makes me worry.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please don't look so anxious.
Truly, it will be all right.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Would you please believe in me
and allow me to continue training?
choice_data_list: If it's a manageable menu, then...

text_block_list.text:
I don't want you pushing yourself and worsening the injury.
If that happens, you won't be able to run for even longer.
I reasoned that we must avoid that, even if the risk is slim.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...If you insist that much,
I suppose I have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I shall quietly take my rest.
Trampling on your pure concern is the last thing I would desire.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I will proceed with the utmost care.
I kept an eye on her with a light routine, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It seems best to rest quietly for now.

Because Dream Journey's injury worsened,
we decided to have her rest for a while.
I kept an eye on her with a light routine, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
There is no pain, either. I believe it's safe to say
there will be no lingering effects going forward.
choice_data_list: Let's keep a careful eye on how things go.

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Dream Journey overcame her injury
and made a smooth return to racing.
